name: url-kit
title: URL Kit
description: Encode, decode or shorten a URL from the clipboard. Shortening sends the clipboard's URL to TinyURL.
author: black

commands.name: encode
commands.title: URL Encode
commands.description: Percent-encode the clipboard, prefilled into a field you can edit.

commands.name: decode
commands.title: URL Decode
commands.description: Decode percent-escapes in the clipboard, reading + as a space in a query.

commands.name: shorten
commands.title: Shorten URL
commands.description: Turn the clipboard into a TinyURL link, prefilled into a field you can edit.
